paper_verdict.pooling_concerns: Outcome is RGDP level in constant US$ (implausible descriptives), exposure is a mean-zero PCA index, effects are VAR lag-1 coefficients whose units are not elasticities; authors misread Table 11; regression N not reported; poorly suited for pooling.

estimates.note: Recorded value is row ICT(t), column RGDP(t-1), i.e. lagged RGDP -> ICT. Table 10 Granger p-values match the row=equation, column=lagged-regressor layout. n_obs/n_countries are Table 4 descriptive counts, not regression N; group obs imply different country counts than stated.
